doc.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Aging and feeling good at 75
summary: Looking at Wilson at 91, he says you are as old as you feel.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: It’s great. You know, and I am looking at Gerald and Gerald’s 90-what? What is he 90…?
…I’m 75, but still, I’m still going to grow up to be like him, you know?
I had another friend the other day…what’s today, Wednesday? Yesterday he was 96…
…and he just is as spry as anybody I know and loves jazz. He was a(n) alto player for a while but gave it up for other things. But the point is I guess you’re as old as you feel…
…you know. And I don’t feel too old. I’m going to be 80 next year. And, but I’m feeling good. I got a little sore throat, but otherwise, I’m feeling really, really good.
